canonical_name: Backup Isolation from Production Not Implemented
description: Backup systems are not isolated from production networks to prevent compromise. This signal indicates that ransomware or other attacks may compromise both production and backup data.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments with critical backup requirements. Includes air-gapped backups, immutable storage, and isolated backup networks.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through backup architecture review, network isolation verification, and backup immutability testing.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
